root_causes: The former local BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embedding index missed Dutch paraphrases and later corrections.
The former retention document combined the user turn and Eva reply while assigning the whole document direct_user trust.
A whole-sentence query could bury one decisive place or object term, and synonymous household names such as overkapping and veranda were not reliably connected.

implemented_boundaries.operational_conversation: PostgreSQL retains the complete immutable user and assistant exchange.
implemented_boundaries.direct_user_semantic_source: Hindsight receives only the literal user utterance; assistant output is never stored with direct_user trust.
implemented_boundaries.cold_path: retain remains asynchronous and reflect remains stale-only/nightly.
implemented_boundaries.hot_path: Hindsight recall stays low-budget with 2048 final-context tokens and node budget 40.
implemented_boundaries.paraphrase_retrieval: The full query and neutral lexical anchors run in parallel; genuinely memory-dependent questions can first produce a low-reasoning, answer-free synonym plan that Hindsight must resolve to stored evidence.
implemented_boundaries.hypothetical_safety: Questions and benchmark scenarios are not extracted as user preferences unless the user explicitly asserts a fact.
